input: # Three reports that say what a description holds beyond its
# references: the implicit mapping of a discriminator, a reference
# that lands on another type than it expects, and the URLs a
# description gives for things outside it. Each row selects the
# version alone from the tree, since none of them changes the tree.
# The implicit mapping. The value of a discriminator's property is the
# name of a schema component, unless `mapping` has that value. Beside
# `oneOf` or `anyOf` the components it can name are the ones listed by
# reference: an inline schema has no name, and neither has a reference
# to something that is no component.

{"openapi":"3.1.0","components":{"schemas":{"Pet":{"oneOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Cat"},{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Dog"},{"type":"object"},{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Cat/properties/x"}],"discriminator":{"propertyName":"kind"}},"Cat":{"properties":{"x":{}}},"Dog":{}}}}
{"openapi":"3.0.3","components":{"schemas":{"Pet":{"anyOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Cat"},{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Dog"}],"discriminator":{"propertyName":"kind"}},"Cat":{},"Dog":{}}}}
# A value that `mapping` has is that entry's, whatever it names, and
# has no implicit row.

{"openapi":"3.1.0","components":{"schemas":{"Pet":{"oneOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Cat"},{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Dog"}],"discriminator":{"propertyName":"kind","mapping":{"Cat":"#/components/schemas/Dog","hound":"Dog"}}},"Cat":{},"Dog":{}}}}
# On a parent schema, the components that build on it with `allOf`
# can each be named, and so can the ones that build on those. A
# reference to the parent through another reference counts, and an
# `allOf` of anything else does not.

{"openapi":"3.0.3","components":{"schemas":{"Pet":{"discriminator":{"propertyName":"petType"},"properties":{"petType":{"type":"string"}}},"Cat":{"allOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Pet"},{"type":"object"}]},"Lion":{"allOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Cat"}]},"Alias":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Pet"},"Fish":{"allOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Alias"}]},"Rock":{"allOf":[{"type":"object"}]},"Tree":{"properties":{"p":{"allOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Pet"}]}}}}}}
# A component listed beside the discriminator and building on its
# schema as well is named once. A loop of `allOf` ends, with each
# schema on it named once, the first among them.

{"openapi":"3.1.0","components":{"schemas":{"Pet":{"oneOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Cat"}],"discriminator":{"propertyName":"kind"},"allOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Dog"}]},"Cat":{"allOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Pet"}]},"Dog":{"allOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Cat"}]}}}}
# A schema that is no component can have a discriminator too, and a
# reference by identifier or anchor names the component it lands on.

{"openapi":"3.1.0","paths":{"/p":{"get":{"responses":{"200":{"description":"ok","content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"oneOf":[{"$ref":"https://x.example/cat"},{"$ref":"#dog"}],"discriminator":{"propertyName":"kind"}}}}}}}}},"components":{"schemas":{"Cat":{"$id":"https://x.example/cat"},"Dog":{"$anchor":"dog"}}}}

# implicit rows.
{"openapi":"3.2.0","components":{"schemas":{"Pet":{"oneOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Cat"}],"discriminator":{"propertyName":"kind","defaultMapping":"Other"}},"Cat":{},"Other":{}}}}
# In 2.0 the discriminator is the name of the property, and its value
# is the name of this schema or of one that inherits it.

{"swagger":"2.0","definitions":{"Pet":{"discriminator":"petType","properties":{"petType":{"type":"string"}}},"Cat":{"allOf":[{"$ref":"#/definitions/Pet"},{"type":"object"}]},"Lion":{"allOf":[{"$ref":"#/definitions/Cat"}]}}}

# 2.0 form in 3.0 and the 3.0 form in 2.0, and one in an example. One
# in a schema that declares another dialect is a discriminator all the

{"openapi":"3.0.3","components":{"schemas":{"A":{"oneOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/B"}],"discriminator":{"mapping":{}}},"B":{"oneOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/A"}],"discriminator":"kind"},"E":{"example":{"oneOf":[{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/B"}],"discriminator":{"propertyName":"k"}}}}}}
